summary: FERC grants ISO-NE and the Participating Transmission Owners a 90-day abeyance of the E-11 show cause proceeding, moving responses to November 16, 2026 and answers to December 16, 2026, and records the five reform categories ISO-NE plans to file.

points.point: FERC grants the August 3 abeyance motion for 90 days.
points.quote: we grant the Abeyance Motion filed by Joint Movants and hold this proceeding in abeyance for 90 days.

points.point: The stakeholder schedule runs through a PTO-AC vote in October and a NEPOOL Participants Committee vote in November.
points.quote: the PTO-AC plans to act on Tariff revisions in October, and the NEPOOL Participants Committee would vote on the FPA section 205 proposal at its November meeting.

points.point: Planned filing covers study procedures, including alternative transmission technologies, and a large load definition fitted to ISO-NE's system.
points.quote: the FPA section 205 filing will address the need for a transmission service application process and study procedures, including the evaluation of alternative transmission technologies.

points.point: It will bar netting behind-the-meter generation with load behind the same point of interconnection for Regional Network Service charges.
points.quote: behind-the meter generation (BTMG) cannot be netted with load behind the same point of interconnection for the purpose of determining Regional Network Service charges

points.point: Planned flexible services: interim non-firm network service and permanent firm and non-firm contract demand service.
points.quote: (1) interim non-firm network transmission service; (2) permanent firm contract demand transmission service; and (3) permanent non-firm contract demand transmission service.

points.point: Responses are due November 16, 2026 and answers December 16, 2026; a section 205 filing by November 16 suspends that respondent's duty to respond.
points.quote: responses to the Show Cause Order will be due on November 16, 2026, and answers to responses will be due on December 16, 2026.

throughLine.text: Moves the E-11 order's 60-day deadline to November 16, 2026 and records ISO-NE's plan to address application and study, cost-recovery, BTMG netting, flexible service and proximate-generation study in one section 205 filing.

figures.label: Abeyance period granted for ISO-NE show cause
figures.quote: hold this proceeding in abeyance for 90 days
